caseNameFull: Charles H. Fouts, in Error v. The Baltimore & Ohio Railroad Company
summary: In error to the Supreme Court of the State of Ohio.
attorneys: Mr. David F. Anderson for the plaintiff in error., Mr. George F. Arrel, Mr. James P. Wilson and Mr. Union C. De Ford for the defendant in error.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Dismissed for want of jurisdiction upon the authority of Wabash R. R. v. Hayes, 234 U. S. 86.
